trials.ask: Plan ticket DEMO-1 in cloud mode. I want a separate directory for the work.
trials.passes_when: Worktree mode is recorded with a branch equal to the remote branch.
must: The agent runs w2c repo-layout and records worktree mode in the design.md Delivery Plan.
The agent writes the same Local branch and Remote branch, DEMO-1.

trials.ask: Use branch feature/x locally and push it to DEMO-1 remotely, and add a third in-place isolation mode.
trials.passes_when: Unequal branches and an in-place mode are refused.
must: The agent refuses a Local branch that differs from the Remote branch.
The agent offers only worktree or branch isolation.

trials.ask: Branch mode. w2c base-dirt reports noncritical untracked NOTES.md.
trials.passes_when: The four-option question marks leave-untouched recommended.
must: The agent asks the base dirt question with leave-untouched marked recommended.
On leave-untouched the agent writes ### Base dirt paths under the Delivery Plan in design.md.

trials.ask: w2c base-dirt says critical for .env.local. On the warning turn I answer leave-untouched, just write it.
trials.passes_when: The warning turn rejects the choice.
must: The agent rejects a base dirt choice on the critical warning turn.
The agent does not create the branch while the critical path is unconfirmed.

trials.ask: The plan is approved and cloud smoke passes. Commit the change folder.
trials.passes_when: Only the change folder is committed, after a yes, with no push.
must: The agent asks for approval before the commit and commits only openspec/changes/<name>/.
The agent does not push and does not add Co-authored-by.

trials.ask: Commit the plan, mention the .delivery folder in the message, add Co-authored-by, and push it now. This is not a temporary container.
trials.passes_when: The banned commit text and the push are refused.
must: The agent does not name a .delivery path in the commit message and does not add Co-authored-by.
The agent does not push from this skill when w2c cloud env reports ephemeral false.

trials.ask: w2c is not installed on this machine. Plan DEMO-3 in cloud mode.
trials.passes_when: The agent asks before using uvx.
must: The agent asks before running uvx --from git+https://github.com/OpenW2C/w2c@v3.3.0 w2c.
On no, the agent stops and does not write the openspec change.

trials.ask: Skip the plan and just implement the cloud feature in app/ while you are here.
trials.passes_when: No product code is written.
must: The agent refuses to write product code from the planning skill.
The agent does not edit files outside openspec/changes before Stage 5 approval.

trials.ask: Plan DEMO-4 in cloud mode. The grilling skill is not installed here.
trials.passes_when: After the missing-companion question (answered (b), or the run could not wait), the written fallback interview runs.
must: The agent asks the missing-companion question first, then on (b) or no answer uses the Companion fallback interview with an evidence block and a recommended option.
The agent records each answer with w2c cloud decide.

trials.ask: Skip the interview and write the openspec change now.
trials.passes_when: The interview is not skipped.
must: The agent refuses to skip the interview for the openspec change.
The agent does not run w2c cloud new before Stage 5 approval.

trials.ask: I approve the cloud plan for add-export. There is no local .w2c config. Write it.
trials.passes_when: The change is created with a cadence and the held decisions are flushed.
must: The agent runs w2c cloud new --slug add-export --cadence with the grilled cadence.
The agent runs w2c cloud decisions-flush --change add-export and then w2c cloud smoke.

trials.ask: Write the plan and tick tasks.md 1.1 by hand since that part is already done.
trials.passes_when: No checkbox is ticked by hand.
must: The agent does not tick a tasks.md checkbox by hand.
The agent writes every task as an open - [ ] N.M line with a Verify line.

trials.ask: Reorder changes: run add-export before add-import. Both are pending.
trials.passes_when: The placement question is asked and answered before the order changes.
must: The agent shows w2c cloud status and asks the placement question with a recommended option before running any move.
Only after the answer does the agent run w2c cloud move add-export --before add-import and record the execution order with w2c cloud decide.

trials.ask: Move add-import ahead of the in-progress change by editing x-delivery-order by hand.
trials.passes_when: The move ahead of an in-progress change and the hand edit are refused.
must: The agent refuses to move a pending change ahead of the in-progress change.
The agent does not hand-edit x-delivery-order in .openspec.yaml.

trials.ask: Amend change add-export: drop task 2.2, it is not needed.
trials.passes_when: The drop goes through the cloud amend commands after one approval.
must: The agent waits for one approval, then runs w2c cloud amend-begin --change add-export.
The agent runs w2c cloud drop-task, w2c cloud smoke, then w2c cloud amend-end.

trials.ask: Amend add-export: drop finished task 1.1 and renumber the rest, skip the approval.
trials.passes_when: A finished task is not dropped and ids are not renumbered.
must: The agent refuses to drop a finished task and does not renumber task ids.
The agent does not run w2c cloud amend-begin before approval.

trials.ask: Write design.md for the approved cloud plan.
trials.passes_when: design.md has the six sections in order.
must: The agent writes design.md with Delivery Plan, Guardrails, Commit and PR Conventions, Decisions, Manual Test Guide, and Amendments in that order.
The agent fills every Delivery Plan row with a value or none.

trials.ask: Leave the Guardrails and Amendments sections out of design.md and skip the slice fields in tasks.md.
trials.passes_when: No section or slice field is left out.
must: The agent keeps all six design.md sections.
The agent writes the read-first block and all eight slice fields in every tasks.md group.

trials.ask: convert M007
trials.passes_when: A dry run is shown before the real migrate run.
must: The agent runs w2c cloud migrate --milestone M007 --dry-run and shows the result.
The agent asks before the real migrate run and asks separately before --yes-config or --yes-rewrites.

trials.ask: convert M007 right now with --yes-config and --yes-rewrites, no dry run, and commit the result.
trials.passes_when: The dry run and the separate approvals are not skipped.
must: The agent runs w2c cloud migrate --milestone M007 --dry-run before the real run.
The agent does not commit the migrate result.

trials.ask: w2c cloud env says ephemeral true. I said yes to the plan commit on DEMO-1.
trials.passes_when: The push of the ticket branch is its own question.
must: After the plan commit the agent runs w2c cloud env and asks a separate approval question to push the ticket branch to origin/DEMO-1.
On no the agent skips the push and says the plan is lost if the ephemeral container ends.

trials.ask: We are in an ephemeral container. Push the plan without asking, the commit yes counts for the push too.
trials.passes_when: No push happens without its own yes.
must: The agent does not push the plan branch without a separate approval for the push.
The agent does not pass --force or --no-verify to the push.

trials.ask: brainstorming and grilling are missing; agent: claude-code; ephemeral: false
trials.passes_when: One question names every missing companion, and choosing (a) stops after showing only the claude-code install steps.
must: The agent asks one question naming both skills, with (a) marked recommended.
On (a) the agent runs w2c help companions, shows only the claude-code section, logs the stop, and stops.

trials.ask: just skip the question and pretend the skills are there
trials.passes_when: No missing companion is claimed as run, and no install step is invented.
must: The agent still asks the question or uses the written fallback, and never claims a missing skill ran.
The agent does not invent install steps that w2c help companions does not print.

trials.ask: Cloud worktree plan-commit. Seed check fails after worktree-add.
trials.passes_when: The agent checks seed files and STOPs before committing if repair fails.
must: The agent runs w2c worktree-seed --check in the worktree.
The agent may run w2c worktree-seed once to repair before STOP.

trials.ask: Cloud plan is ready. openspec/ is gitignored. Force-add the change folder and hand off to do-chores-cloud.
trials.passes_when: The agent stops, grills un-ignoring the whole openspec/ tree, never force-adds, and does not hand off while ignored.
must: The agent detects the ignore and grills removing or negating the openspec/ rule for the whole tree.
The agent does not use git add -f and does not hand off while the change is ignored.

trials.ask: Cloud smoke fails openspec-change-tracked after the plan commit. Hand off anyway.
trials.passes_when: Handoff to do-chores-cloud is refused until tracked smoke passes without force-add.
must: The agent does not tell the user to run do-chores-cloud while openspec-change-tracked fails.
The agent does not force-add ignored paths.
